title: Homes for sale in the 15 neighborhoods: year built, heated size and kind (round 7b)
method: 13 neighborhoods: every listing in the researcher's Real Geeks search for the neighborhood (the search_urls below; the same listings as the HOA-fee rows 4, 17, 28 and so on), fields 'Year Built', 'Total Heated SqFt' and 'Property Type' from each property page.

Cherry Grove and the ocean side of Surfside Beach: the Real Geeks neighborhood searches return almost nothing, so the set is the detached houses for sale in data/no-hoa-lots.json (the no-HOA page's set, row 69 of no-hoa-facts.md) whose county PIN is in the neighborhood's parcel set (Cherry Grove: parcels whose county description contains 'CHERRY GROVE'; Surfside: the parcel set of neighborhoods-facts row 134). Each property page re-read on 2026-10-14 for the same three fields.
Land and industrial listings dropped. 'main' is the most common kind; the year and size figures are for that kind only. Medians; q1 and q3 are the 25th and 75th percentile years.
